kjv: I (Paul) perceive that in all things ye (the Athenians) are too superstitious
mine: I (Paul) perceive that in every way you (the Athenians) are very religious
note: deisidaimonesterous can be positive or negative, but Paul is opening a courteous speech (captatio benevolentiae) and goes on to cite their altar; "too superstitious" makes his first words an insult.

kjv: hath made of one blood all nations
mine: he (God) made from one man every nation
note: TR adds "haimatos" (blood); absent from P74, Sinaiticus, A, B.

kjv: that the Godhead is like unto gold
mine: that the divine being is like gold
note: to theion is "the divine, deity", a philosophical term suited to the Athenian audience; "Godhead" suggests the Trinitarian term (cf. Col 2:9 "theotes", Rom 1:20 "theiotes").
